description: Pure-F10.7 stress sweep: solar-min 2019 (Ap ≤ 12) with F10.7 multiplied by 10× to reach 700 SFU. Decouples the F10.7 axis from the Ap axis so the stress report can isolate the predictor's F10.7-sensitivity from its storm-coupling response.
warnings: F10.7 = 716 SFU exceeds the predictor's training maximum of 315 SFU; predictions here are extrapolations and must be checked for monotonicity / smoothness only, not accuracy.
